agreementLifecycle.breach: Only a committed attack event explicitly ordered/endorsed by a bound party can trigger this draft term. Lone-cat dislike, unrelated hazard or rumor is not a pride breach. Unknown authority remains unresolved. No new combat system implied.
agreementLifecycle.knowledge: World breach truth and who knows it are separate. A private breach may exist without uninformed leaders accusing a party. Witnessing/relay at a later scene teaches named recipients only.
agreementLifecycle.consequences: Tundra supplies explicit directional deltas and operational effects. Apply breach/fulfilment once per agreement/term/source-event receipt. Do not mirror edges or change player standing without a specific sourced rule.

checks: All actual leaders included with stable IDs/names/traits through Save/Continue; no old role name forced as display name.
Disagreement preserves inactive proposal and chosen terms; no agreement from two unrelated bystander approvals.
Terms do not mutate when reloaded; changed terms need revision and fresh assent from required parties.
One authorised breach updates only explicitly mapped records once; personal hostility/rumor never qualifies.
Unknown-to-leader source cannot become a factual accusation. Explicit disclosure adds recipients but no invisible pride-wide spread.

personalityCoverage.status: DRAFT full authored speech-location coverage, not runtime acceptance. Numeric band cuts and presentation policies proposed. No actual ln05 trait values assumed.
personalityCoverage.authority: Saved per-run cat personality from world-gen §5 / genetics §4. ln05 hidden-parent inheritance requires the generation resolver, not a founder shortcut or narrative lean.

inputContract.missing: Emit characterization_unresolved and preserve pending cursor. A diagnostic baseline may be displayed only if explicitly labelled incomplete, never counted as consistent-character coverage. Do not create personality values here.
inputContract.provenance: Each rendered beat records characterDataVersion, saved traits snapshot/reference, fact IDs and selected variant ID. Do not expose hidden numerical traits in ordinary player UI.

renderPolicy: First resolve the original history/knowledge/promise branch. Then read this exact speech-location row. Never use traits to invent a remembered event or skip a fact gate.

Band each trait: low <=30, high >=70, otherwise middle (authoring defaults, not new mechanics). Focus trait selects the full high/low utterance; middle retains the row base. Values at or near 50 describe a coherent moderate personality, not missing data.

Choose one visible action from that context: use focused trait if extreme; otherwise use the most extreme remaining trait (absolute distance from50; stable tie order requiredTraits). If all are middle, use neutral action: {catName} waits for your answer without hurrying you. Low/high actions are intentional NPC behavior, not combat/flee/hunt rolls.

Secondary constraints always apply: low sociability bounds closeness, high sociability can seek company without overriding quiet/consent; aggression changes how firmly limits are defended, never auto-attacks; boldness changes who initiates/sets pace, never invents a hazard; loyalty favors reliable limits but does not guarantee agreement or give loner pride loyalty; curiosity invites clarification, never grants unknown facts.

Relationship context may keep physical distance/guardedness or permit closeness only when actual chosen branch allows it. Do not reverse the saved personality. Positive affinity is not consent, negative affinity not an automatic fight, and Permanent Rival is not locked.

Player choice labels remain player-authored intentions. Do not rewrite the player to sound like the NPC or hide exit/repair/honest disagreement because of NPC traits. NPC personality appears in invitation/limits and the selected choice’s response/action; original stable choice/outcome IDs remain unchanged.

Text is composed BEFORE showing the node, then saved with selected variant/action IDs and exact pending cursor. Continue restores that presentation; no live RNG, rerender to a different choice set, extra receipt, or new cost.

Online/local/offline paths share these facts, trait inputs, branch/response/choice constraints. Generative modes may paraphrase within that envelope but cannot invent promises, change outcome/gate or omit the selected behavior. Offline has every row explicitly authored.

For terminal replies, resolve the chosen answer and its unchanged receipt once, save the response/cursor, and show the response. Reopening/restoring cannot apply effects again. Rendering an invitation or request does not resolve a promise.
personalityCoverage.npcDecisions: The context action is an actual visible NPC choice of distance, initiative, pacing, questioning or enforcing a limit. It must appear in the scene, not remain an unused tag. New trust checks, denial gates, resource costs or mechanical preference deltas require separate approved/proposed rule mapping, not this authoring pass.
